input_contract.text_input: exactly one of utf8 or hex; hex denotes raw bytes before UTF-8 validation
input_contract.valid_value_result: value.from=input requires byte-for-byte preservation of the decoded input
input_contract.generator_expansion: inclusive zero-based indices in ascending order

indexed_text.expansion: prefix followed by the zero-padded base-10 index for each index in 0..count

indexed_edges.expansion: for edge index i in 0..edge_count, from is phase_prefix plus zero-padded ((i / phase_count) modulo phase_count), and to is phase_prefix plus zero-padded (i modulo phase_count)

alternating_transition_history.expansion: start in first; record i has sequence i, from the current phase, and to the other phase for every i in 1..=count

distinct_relationship_edges.expansion: count complete keys in ascending index order; each UUID is the fixed 12-byte zero prefix plus the four-byte big-endian index, formatted as lowercase RFC-4122 text with version nibble 4 and variant nibble 8

distinct_associations.expansion: count whole-unit associations in ascending index order, with value equal to value_prefix followed by the zero-padded three-digit base-10 index

indexed_account_id32.expansion: for each index in start..start+count, encode the index as four-byte big-endian and prepend 28 zero bytes; render the resulting 32-byte AccountId32 as lowercase hex without a prefix
